raw_text: [0.54][S01] To figure out what something's worth and you have to kind of weigh it.[3.27][4.08][S01] He talked about the difference between, he said, "The stock market in the short term is a voting[8.88][8.88][S01] machine.[9.57][9.57][S01] It represents speculative interests, you know, supply and demand of people in the short[14.88][14.88][S01] term.[15.33][15.33][S01] But in the long term, the stock market is a weighing machine.[17.67][18.36][S01] You're much more accurate.[19.38][19.68][S01] It's going to tell you what something's worth.[21.12][21.36][S01] And so if you can divine what something's worth, then you can really take advantage[25.41][25.41][S01] of the market because it's really here to to help you.[27.81][28.02][S01] And that's kind of the message of.[28.98]
